I’d start with **BeFrugal** if you want cash back. It had the highest advertised cashback rate in the November 22, 2026 CheckBeforeYouShop snapshot. The best value for your order depends on your item category and how much you value each program’s rewards.

- **Cashback:** Up to **10.1%**. [BeFrugal offer (affiliate link)](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/go/befrugal?plc=api&m=f420947b-4ae5-4acd-9d20-67919de592ec)
- **Airline miles:** Up to **3 AAdvantage miles per $1**. [American AAdvantage eShopping offer (affiliate link)](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/go/aa-eshopping?plc=api&m=f420947b-4ae5-4acd-9d20-67919de592ec)
- **Points:** Up to **15 MyPoints points per $1**. [MyPoints offer (affiliate link)](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/go/mypoints?plc=api&m=f420947b-4ae5-4acd-9d20-67919de592ec)

Those are maximums. Check the rate that applies to your items before ordering. Source: [CheckBeforeYouShop’s Home Depot listing](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/m/the-home-depot). Portal offer links may earn CheckBeforeYouShop a referral bonus.
